The '''Banana Slakoth Garden''' (Japanese: '''バナナナマケロ園''' ''Banana {{tt|Namakero|Slakoth}} Garden'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Hoenn]] found between [[Fortree City]] and [[Lilycove City]]. 

The garden is a large banana plantation and boasts the largest {{p|Slakoth}} population in the world. The bananas, aside from feeding the Slakoth, also go into making banana-flavored desserts for visitors to enjoy.

The garden appeared in ''[[AG088|The Garden of Eatin']]'', where it was in danger of closing because a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Snorlax}} was eating all of the bananas. After receiving some questions from {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}, [[Marcel]], the garden's director, realized that Snorlax was displaced from its mountain home due to an encroaching construction site that was set up a month ago. In addition to eating all of the food, Snorlax used its {{m|Yawn}} to make other Pokémon fall {{status|sleep|asleep}}. Marcel used his newly [[Evolution|evolved]] {{p|Vigoroth}} to oppose Snorlax; Vigoroth's {{a|Vital Spirit}} rendered Yawn ineffective. Marcel later {{pkmn2|caught}} Snorlax and created a relaxation attraction featuring Snorlax's Yawn move. Since there is now a Vigoroth in the garden, Marcel decided to rename it the "Banana Slakoth and Vigoroth Garden".
